pois.name: Colosseum
pois.address: Piazza del Colosseo, 1, 00184 Roma RM, Italy
pois.description: The largest ancient amphitheatre ever built, holding gladiatorial contests and public spectacles under the Roman Empire.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic UNESCO World Wonder
✓ Ancient Roman monument dating to 70-80 AD
✓ 4.8★ reviews
pois.tip: Book timed-entry tickets well in advance to bypass long ticket queues.

pois.name: Roman Forum & Palatine Hill
pois.address: Via della Salara Vecchia, 5/6, 00186 Roma RM, Italy
pois.description: Rectangular forum surrounded by the ruins of ancient government buildings at the center of Roman civilization.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Heart of the ancient Roman Republic and Empire
✓ Sweeping panoramic views from Palatine Hill
pois.tip: Wear comfortable walking shoes with sturdy grip as the ancient basalt pavers can be uneven.

pois.name: Pantheon
pois.address: Piazza della Rotonda, 00186 Roma RM, Italy
pois.description: Former Roman temple, now a Catholic church, famed for its massive unreinforced concrete dome and open central oculus.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Best-preserved ancient Roman building with magnificent central oculus
✓ 4.8★ reviews
pois.tip: Visit around midday when the sunlight streams directly through the oculus creating spectacular sunbeams.

pois.name: Trevi Fountain
pois.address: Piazza di Trevi, 00187 Roma RM, Italy
pois.description: Monumental 18th-century Baroque fountain depicting Oceanus on a shell chariot flanked by Tritons and sea horses.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-famous Baroque masterpiece
✓ Free public access
✓ Evening illumination is breathtaking
pois.tip: Toss a coin with your right hand over your left shoulder to ensure a future return to Rome.

pois.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
pois.description: Christian and art museums exhibiting immense collections amassed by popes throughout centuries, culminating in Michelangelo's Sistine ceiling.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unparalleled Renaissance masterpieces by Michelangelo, Raphael, and Leonardo
✓ World-renowned gallery
pois.tip: Pre-purchase official timed tickets to bypass lengthy queues outside the Vatican walls.

pois.name: Piazza Navona
pois.description: Elongated Baroque piazza built on the former Stadium of Domitian, featuring Bernini's Fontana dei Quattro Fiumi.
pois.ai_reason: ✓ Magnificent open-air square with Bernini fountains, street musicians, and cafes
pois.tip: Grab artisanal gelato from a nearby gelateria and enjoy an evening stroll around the central fountain.
